scope: Production store scheduling and queue handoff with fixed instants and real SQLite.

cases.name: spring missing minute
cases.result: No new Task or queued run for the missing local minute. The next valid day queues one new Planner.

cases.name: fall repeated minute
cases.result: The repeated local minute creates no duplicate occurrence or run. The next day queues one new Planner.

riskControls: Overlap ALLOW prevents an active initial Task from hiding a duplicate through overlap suppression.
The test checks occurrence counts, queued Planner counts, and the exact next valid instant.

limits: The unit cases supply fixed instants to the production scheduler. The live server clock was unchanged.
These cases verify stored occurrence creation and queue handoff. Live provider execution is covered separately by the deadline tests.
The existing schedule package covers preview output; this added test covers the stored transition boundary.
